chunks: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ruled concerning an animal upon which there were two riders: if the animal killed a man or injured him, then he ruled that the compensation should be divided equally between the two riders.

key_terms.الْغَرَامَةِ: Financial liability or compensation due for the harm.
key_terms.بِالسَّوِيَّةِ: Equally, in equal shares between the two parties.
key_terms.دَابَّةٍ: A riding animal or beast involved in causing the harm.
key_terms.رَدِيفَانِ: Two persons riding together on the same animal.

ai.seo_question: How is compensation divided when an animal carrying two riders kills or injures someone?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام concerning liability when an animal carrying two riders causes death or injury to a person. The ruling assigns the financial compensation equally between the two riders, establishing shared responsibility in this case.
